info.title: Sanad Support Bot
info.description: Ask the Sanad internal support bot a question and get a human-approved answer with a match score, or an explicit "I do not know" that is queued for a trainer. Sanad never lets a language model write the user-facing reply.

post.description: Sends one question to Sanad and returns the approved answer, a set of suggestions, or an explicit unknown. Arabic and English are both accepted.

400.description: The session or the text field is missing.

429.description: This session sent more than 20 questions in one minute.

500.description: Sanad failed to process the question.

post.description: Records one vote on an answer that Sanad already returned. A negative vote sends the original question back to the trainer queue.

400.description: The chat id is missing, or the vote is not 1 or -1.

500.description: Sanad failed to record the vote.

get.summary: List questions waiting for a trainer
get.description: Returns every pending question, grouped so that near duplicate questions arrive as one item with its variants attached.

200.description: The list of pending question groups.

401.description: The Authorization header is missing or the token is wrong.

500.description: Sanad failed to read the queue.

get.description: Returns counters for the answer base, the pending queue, the instant answer rate, and satisfaction. Useful for a scheduled report.

401.description: The Authorization header is missing or the token is wrong.

500.description: Sanad failed to read the statistics.

session.description: A stable identifier for the conversation. Sanad rate limits each session to 20 questions per minute.
session.title: Session

text.description: The question exactly as the employee wrote it. Arabic or English.
text.title: Question

reply.description: The text to show the employee. Always present.
reply.title: Reply
reply.example: افتح صفحة الخدمة الذاتية، ثم اختر تغيير كلمة المرور، وأدخل الرمز الذي يصلك.

suggestions.description: Answer titles offered when the match was uncertain. Null when Sanad was sure or had nothing.
suggestions.title: Suggestions

queued.description: True when Sanad did not know the answer and put the question in the trainer queue.
queued.title: Queued

chat_id.description: The row id of this reply. Pass it to Rate an answer.
chat_id.title: Chat id

MatchedAnswer.description: The approved answer that Sanad matched. Null when nothing matched.
MatchedAnswer.title: Matched answer

answer_id.description: The id of the approved answer in the knowledge base.
answer_id.title: Answer id

title.description: The title of the approved answer.
title.title: Answer title

score.description: The match score between 0 and 1. Sanad answers directly at 0.85 and above, and offers suggestions between 0.55 and 0.85.
score.title: Score

chat_id.description: The chat id returned by Ask Sanad.
chat_id.title: Chat id

vote.description: Use 1 for a helpful answer, or -1 for an unhelpful one. No other value is accepted.
vote.title: Vote

success.description: True when the vote was stored.
success.title: Success

QueueClusterList.description: Pending question groups, ordered by priority and then by newest first.
QueueClusterList.title: Pending questions

QueueCluster.description: One pending question plus the near duplicates folded into it.
QueueCluster.title: Pending question group

question_raw.description: The question exactly as the employee typed it.
question_raw.title: Question

question_norm.description: The normalized form of the question. Diacritics removed and letters unified.
question_norm.title: Normalized question

lang.description: The detected language of the question.
lang.title: Language

status.description: The queue state. This operation returns pending rows only.
status.title: Status

answer_id.description: The answer this question was linked to. Null while the question is pending.
answer_id.title: Answer id

created_at.description: When the question entered the queue.
created_at.title: Created at

priority.description: Set to 1 when the same employee hit an unknown answer twice in a row.
priority.title: Priority

similar_questions.description: Other pending questions that scored 0.75 or higher against this one.
similar_questions.title: Similar questions

variants.description: The raw text of each similar question, as a flat list.
variants.title: Variants

QueueItem.description: One pending question inside a group.
QueueItem.title: Pending question

question_raw.description: The question exactly as the employee typed it.
question_raw.title: Question

question_norm.description: The normalized form of the question.
question_norm.title: Normalized question

lang.description: The detected language of the question.
lang.title: Language

answer_id.description: The answer this question was linked to. Null while pending.
answer_id.title: Answer id

created_at.description: When the question entered the queue.
created_at.title: Created at

priority.description: The escalation flag for this row.
priority.title: Priority

variants.description: How many question phrasings point at those answers.
variants.title: Variants

queue_pending.description: How many questions wait for a trainer.
queue_pending.title: Pending questions

chats.description: How many chat rows are stored, counting both sides.
chats.title: Chat rows

skills.description: How many scripted skills are defined.
skills.title: Skills

training_log.description: The last 20 training events, newest first.
training_log.title: Training log

total_answered.description: How many replies were tied to an approved answer.
total_answered.title: Total answered

instant_answer_rate.description: The percentage of replies in the last 7 days that scored 0.85 or higher.
instant_answer_rate.title: Instant answer rate

user_learned_variants.description: How many phrasings Sanad learned by itself from real questions.
user_learned_variants.title: Learned variants

avg_exam_score.description: The average score of the last exam run, as a percentage. Null when no exam has run.
avg_exam_score.title: Average exam score

overall_satisfaction.description: The percentage of votes that were positive. Returns 100 when no vote exists yet.
overall_satisfaction.title: Satisfaction

embeddings_count.description: How many phrasings have a stored vector.
embeddings_count.title: Embeddings

brain_jobs_pending.description: How many background model jobs are still queued.
brain_jobs_pending.title: Pending model jobs

brain_cache_count.description: How many model verdicts are cached.
brain_cache_count.title: Cached verdicts

pairs_count.description: How many training pairs are stored.
pairs_count.title: Training pairs

event.description: The event name, such as variant_learned or paraphrase_added.
event.title: Event

detail.description: A readable description of the event.
detail.title: Detail
detail.example: Learned variant "وش رصيد الاجازات" for answer ID 42

RateLimitResponse.description: Returned when one session sends more than 20 questions in a minute. Sanad answers in the user voice rather than with an error object.
RateLimitResponse.title: Rate limit reply

reply.description: A friendly slow down message meant to be shown to the employee as is.
reply.title: Reply
reply.example: أعطني نفَساً 😅 أعد المحاولة بعد قليل

api_key.name: Authorization
api_key.description: The value of the SANAD_TOKEN environment variable, written as the word Bearer, one space, then the token.

tags.name: Support
tags.description: Ask a question and rate the answer.

tags.name: Training
tags.description: Read the trainer queue and the knowledge base counters.
